name: 01085 · Westfield, MA
findings: ZIP 01085 (Westfield) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01085 (Westfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01085 (Westfield) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
